name: Ross River Solar Farm
current_developer: Ross River Operations Pty Ltd as the Trustee for the Ross River Operations Trust
notable: 116 MW solar farm near Townsville, QLD. Owned by Palisade Investment Partners. One of the first large-scale solar farms in the Townsville region.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Ross River Solar Farm — Development Application Report (Townsville City Council MCU under SPA 2009), Feb 2016, incl. Appendices F–L
eis_specs.connection_distance_note: ~1.2 km 132 kV underground cable from Ross River Solar Farm to Ross substation
eis_specs.notes: Developed by ESCO Pacific / Palisade / EnergyAustralia (later Genex-related), 116 MWac (~148 MWdc) solar PV. 413,280 JA Solar polycrystalline panels on single-axis trackers over ~202 ha, 20 km south of Townsville. EnergyAustralia offtake PPA; Townsville City Council MCU approval under Sustainable Planning Act 2009; operational 2018.
